authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3196 identifies *kādṛk as the remodelled what interrogative behind Gujarati kaya and Marathi kāy. The kay/kaye forms fit; koī/kɔī needs distinguishing the indefinite pronoun. Reviewed comparator: dhundari_bamore kāy “what?” (f_azbuu5crzsicm). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.
